# Nilathra Collection

> Nilathra Collection is Sri Lanka's premier independent Destination Management Company (DMC) and ultra-luxury travel curator, delivering bespoke island masterplans, sovereign estate buyouts, private VIP aviation, and 24/7 executive stewardship across Sri Lanka and the Maldives.

## Overview
Nilathra Collection evolved from a trusted local execution engine for international top-tier luxury tour brands into an independent DMC. Dedicated exclusively to High-Net-Worth (HNW) and Ultra-High-Net-Worth (UHNW) travelers, family offices, and VIP delegations, Nilathra guarantees complete privacy under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).

## Core Offerings & Services
- **Ultra VIP Masterplans**: Complete tea estate bungalow buyouts, B6/B7 armored ground transport, tarmac jet-side clearance, private helicopter safaris, and dedicated 6-member chef & Ayurvedic master teams.
- **Twin-Island Dual Escapes**: Seamless luxury itineraries combining Ceylon tea highlands and wildlife safaris with private overwater villa retreats in the Maldives via our Male' desk.
- **Accredited Fleet & Chauffeurs**: SLTDA-authorized drivers, expert tour guides, hand-picked safari drivers, private yachts, and air travel operated exclusively with Sri Lanka Air Force or certified zero-fatal-accident partners.
- **Bespoke Concierge & Travel Architecture**: 1:1 direct stewardship with senior directors maintaining strict intake caps (12–15 active journeys per month).

- [Weligama & Mirissa](https://www.nilathra.com/destinations/weligama-mirissa): Private yacht charters and blue whale expeditions.
- [Nuwara Eliya Ceylon Tea Country](https://www.nilathra.com/destinations/nuwara-eliya): Colonial tea estate bungalows and cool climate retreats.
- [Trincomalee East Coast](https://www.nilathra.com/destinations/trincomalee): Unspoiled white sand beaches and marine sanctuaries.
- [Colombo Sovereign Capital](https://www.nilathra.com/destinations/colombo): Tarmac VIP arrivals, fine dining, and colonial architecture.
